scripts.dev: npm run index && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local --import tsx dev/server.ts
scripts.esm-check: rm -rf .esm-check && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .esm-check --rootDir . && node --input-type=module -e "await import('./.esm-check/api/[[...path]].js'); console.log('api entry loads as plain Node ESM')" && rm -rf .esm-check
scripts.ci: npm run index && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run esm-check
scripts.deploy: npm run ci && vercel pull --yes --environment=production && vercel build --prod && vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod
